evidence.quote: Personal access tokens are for personal development, like building an integration for yourself, your client, or your company.
OAuth access tokens are recommended for building an integration where other users grant your service access to Airtable's API on their behalf.
From /create/tokens, click the 'Create new token' button to create a new personal access token.
Once your token is created, we will only show it to you once, so we encourage you to copy it to your clipboard and store it somewhere safe.
The API closely follows REST semantics, uses JSON to encode objects, and relies on standard HTTP codes to signal operation outcomes.
Any MCP-compatible tool can read, write, and query your bases through natural language, scoped to your existing permissions.
As of February 1st, 2024, the deprecation period for Airtable API keys has ended

result.notes: Airtable API keys were fully deprecated (removed) as of Feb 1, 2024, replaced by personal access tokens (bearer_token, self-serve at /create/tokens, no paid-plan gate found) and OAuth2 for third-party integrations. Official MCP server distributed via npm (@airtable/mcp-cli) and documented at airtable.com/developers/agents. Did not verify exact endpoint count for api_breadth (estimated medium based on typical REST resource set: records, bases, tables, fields, views, webhooks, comments, attachments).
result.one_liner: Airtable is a cloud spreadsheet-database hybrid for building apps and workflows around structured data.
